seo.title: Add a Watermark to a PDF Online — Free & Secure | JDpdf
seo.description: Stamp a text watermark across every page of a PDF. Free, fast, and private — no installation required.

subtitle: Add a text watermark across every page of a PDF file.

howItWorks.title: How to add a watermark to a PDF
steps: Upload the PDF file you want to watermark.
Type the text you want stamped on every page.
Click Add watermark and download the result.

items.a: Yes, adding a watermark is free within the daily usage limits shown above.

items.q: Is the watermark added to every page?
items.a: Yes, the same watermark text is stamped diagonally across every page of the file.

items.q: Will my file be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Files are processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period.
